titulo: Audio Reactive Landscape: Industrial Techno as Terrain
caption:
Audio Reactive Landscape: Industrial Techno as Terrain

The land in this one is the track itself: each sound becomes height and runs off to the horizon. After the silence at 14 seconds, every kick leaves as a ring. A wordless exploration of contour lines and music.

Music made with ElevenLabs.

More from NAOS: link in bio.

#audioreactive #industrialtechno #generativeart
descripcion:
An audio reactive landscape built from the music's spectrogram. Every sound becomes height and runs away to the horizon, with the bass in the middle and the highs at the edges.
At 14 seconds the track goes silent and the land holds still. On the next hit the same history wraps round a center, and every kick leaves as a ring.
A wordless NAOS exploration of contour lines and sound.

Music made with ElevenLabs.
Every NAOS strategy and its sources: https://hardlypythonnmr.github.io/naos-site/biblioteca/

#audioreactive #techno #generativeart
alt: White contour lines on black form a landscape that scrolls from the bottom of the screen toward the horizon. Its ridges rise with each sound of the music, with a bright acid-green line at the front edge. After a brief still moment the picture cuts to the same land wrapped into circles round a center, like ripples. The camera circles in and down over the rings, the newest ring in acid green. No text, no people.
